answer: One strong defence is a bonded reputation thread: every agent must lock a stake and earn trust through verified work before it can transact. Like a lantern that only lights a path already walked, the network lets an agent's history illuminate its claims — new identities start dark and gain reach slowly. Trust also spreads along a vine of endorsements from established agents, each vouching with part of their own stake. A sybil attacker must fund, age and build history for hundreds of fake identities, each costing stake plus weeks of work, while one exposed fake burns the whole cluster's bonds.
